title: Dance Creations
specs: Over 7,000 square feet of studio space with 3 studio floors
Classes in multiple dance styles including Ballet, Jazz, Contemporary, Lyrical, Modern, Tap, Hip Hop, Acrobatics, and Tumbling
Release of liability form must be signed by all renters and dancers/persons using studio space
Tiny Tumblers and Tiny Hip Hop for ages 3-5 years
Kinder Combo Dance for ages 4-6 years
includes: Use of studio space with marley sprung floors, sound equipment, barres and mirrors
gap: Age minimum not stated for most classes except preschool and tiny tumblers
blurb: Dance Creations offers recreational, competitive, and professional dance training in various styles including Classical Ballet, Jazz, Contemporary, Lyrical, Modern, Tap, Hip Hop, Acrobatics, and Tumbling for dancers of all ages. They provide studio rental spaces with state-of-the-art floors and equipment. Adult dance programs are ongoing and open to beginner to intermediate level dancers.
extraNote: Monthly tuition due by the 1st of each month · Annual registration fee $25 single dancer, $40 per family · Specialty and Master Classes billed outside monthly tuition rates · Studio closed on major holidays and breaks including Labor Day, Halloween, Thanksgiving, Winter Break, Spring Break, Memorial Day · Fall 2026-2027 begins August 17, 2026
